known_risks.lead: Build-start 404 fallback may never trigger: dashboard_decomp_build_lifecycle.js:258 checks `e.status === 404`, but api() (row_model.js:4958-4961) routes through RetirementApiClient.request, which (api_client.js:38-42) does not set err.status. Only the unused fallback branch (row_model.js:4988) sets it.
known_risks.verify: Confirm RetirementApiClient is always defined when api() runs (load order index.html:98 vs row_model at :108) and whether /api/build/start can 404 in any supported runtime. Also check other e.status consumers (only one found).

known_risks.lead: Inconsistent error object shape between the two API paths (status vs fieldErrors) and raw-body errors from RetirementApiClient.text() (api_client.js:52-56) may surface server HTML/tracebacks in messages, partly mitigated by showMessage's splitRawErrorText.
known_risks.verify: Trace callers of RetirementApiClient.text and direct fetch() sites listed under error_handling_surface.

known_risks.lead: Native window.confirm() used for irreversible financial-record actions (close/reopen tax year, mark rollover, replace 1099-B, remove gain, delete cash account), inconsistent with the in-app dialog direction of WI-018; transactions_log.js:183 treats a missing confirm as consent. Behaviour of confirm() inside the pywebview/WebView2 shell not established.
known_risks.verify: Check pywebview_bridge.js for a confirm shim; check whether confirm() messages state consequences and offer undo.

known_risks.lead: Keyboard model of secondary tab strips differs: only the sales ledger tablist implements Arrow/Home/End; others use role=tab buttons with onclick only, and dashboard.js:2877 tablist has no aria-label.
known_risks.verify: Read each tablist renderer for aria-controls/tabpanel, roving tabindex and key handling.

known_risks.lead: Global capture-phase Enter-to-next-field (dashboard.js:6126-6157) changes standard Enter semantics on every input/select outside dialogs; may conflict with search boxes, comboboxes or inputs that expect Enter to submit/apply.
known_risks.verify: Check exclusions (only .helpbtn, .wf-col-width, dialogs) against inputs that bind their own Enter handling (nav search, ledger grid, lot chooser).

known_risks.lead: Many very small fixed font sizes (9-11px: 90 declarations) against a 14px base, no forced-colors/high-contrast handling; text-size control tops at 130%.
known_risks.verify: Determine which surfaces use 9-10px (likely table headers, badges, chips) and whether text_size.js scales them; contrast of --muted on --bg/--soft.

known_risks.lead: High IA churn and recently restructured flows with stated unexercised paths: PR #418 says saving a Record sales entry, a wash-card review and a 1099-B apply were not exercised in the app; PR #390 lists five spec deviations, with follow-up plan documentation/future/superpowers/plans/2026-11-04-left-nav-redesign-followups.md (Status: planned) workstreams A-E still open on its face.
known_risks.verify: Check whether follow-up workstreams A (Maintain footer fallback — a test named suggested_next_maintain_fallback.test.mjs exists), D (Turn-on buttons) and E landed; read sales ledger entry/1099-B handlers.

known_risks.lead: Single header message slot (#actionMessage) carries all feedback; persistent errors stay until dismissed and a new message replaces the previous one; dynamic role switching between status and alert on one element may be announced unreliably by some screen readers.
known_risks.verify: Check whether queued/overlapping messages lose information (e.g. build-finished replacing an unread error) and the prior UX-013 overlap question.

known_risks.lead: Admin Control Center shell lacks a skip link and has a static help aside; prior review UX-006 addressed labels/live region; PR #233 asked for a screen-reader pass on Admin before merge (no record of it found in this pass).
known_risks.verify: Read admin.js render functions for labels and focus handling.

known_risks.verify: Read signin.html, change_password.html, access.js for labels, error messages, lockout feedback.
